content:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm landing a small Terraform module refactor to extract an outputs-shim and gate provider versions. Will pin aws provider to 4.2 for now. Need a fast staging smoke and lockfile regen. PTAL?

chris: link?

maria: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/+/r1234

chris: looking... can you paste the plan snippet here? I want to confirm no resource drift.

maria: pasted plan — small change: output module path updates only, no resource diffs.

```
# terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars
No changes. Outputs changed: module.network.outputs -> module.network-shim.outputs
```

jonah: remember to regen .terraform.lock.hcl after pinning provider. Run:

```
terraform init -upgrade
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64
```

tia: heads-up on k8s secret path — the refactor changes the expected chart value key. Update Helm overlay in infra/charts/app/values-staging.yaml:

```
secrets:
  path: /infra/staging/apps/appname/credentials
```

sam: do you want a canary deploy for this? we can roll the chart to 10% first.

maria: yes please. canary at 10% with 5 minute watch window. @chris can you run the staging smoke after canary?

chris: will do in ~10m :eyes: 

infra-bot: preflight: terraform fmt OK, tfsec scan low-risk, plan succeeded

chris: ran smoke checks. Helm deploy succeeded, pods healthy, app picks up secret path. no errors in logs for 15m. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — I'll merge and follow up with lockfile regen PR. 

jonah: when you regen the lockfile, ping me, I'll run a quick cross-platform lock generation.

maria: will do. merging now.

sam: nice, congrats. :tada:

maria: merged and will open the lockfile PR in 5m.
